subject: maths
title: Primary 1 Ordinal Numbers: First to Tenth
seo_title: P1 Ordinal Numbers Worksheets: Free Primary 1 Maths with Answers (MOE Syllabus)
standard_text: Ordinal numbers (first, second, up to tenth) and symbols (1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc.)
meta_desc: Free P1 maths practice on ordinal numbers: first to tenth, 1st, 2nd, 3rd, left and right, before, after and between. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Find the front first. Ali is 4th, so 3 children are in front of him.
body_html:
Ordinal numbers tell the position

Counting numbers tell how many: one, two, three. Ordinal numbers tell the position: first, second, third. In a queue, start counting at the front.

Words and symbols

SymbolWordSymbolWord
1stfirst6thsixth
2ndsecond7thseventh
3rdthird8theighth
4thfourth9thninth
5thfifth10thtenth

1st, 2nd and 3rd are special. All the others end in “th”.

From the left or from the right

Read the question. Start counting at the end it tells you.

From the right

Which fruit is 2nd from the right?

Start at the right end: mango is 1st, pear is 2nd.

Answer: pear

Before, after and between

Just after 4th comes 5th. Just before 4th comes 3rd. 4th is between 3rd and 5th.

How many are in front?

Ali is 4th in the queue. How many children are in front of him?

In front of him are 1st, 2nd and 3rd. Do not count Ali.

Answer: 3 children

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting from the wrong endFind the front, the left or the right first. Then count
Writing 3th or 2stWrite 1st, 2nd, 3rd. Then 4th, 5th ... 10th
Saying “three” for 3rdSay the position word: third
Counting the child too when asked how many are in front4th in the queue has 3 children in front
Counting both ends as betweenBetween 2nd and 6th are 3rd, 4th, 5th: 3 children

faq.q: What are ordinal numbers in P1 maths?
faq.a: Ordinal numbers tell the position of something, such as first, second and third. Primary 1 students learn first to tenth and the symbols 1st, 2nd, 3rd up to 10th.

faq.q: How do I teach ordinal numbers to my child?
faq.a: Line up toys or family members and ask who is first, second and third. Change where the front is, so your child learns to find the start before counting.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake with ordinal numbers?
faq.a: The most common mistake is counting from the wrong end, such as from the back instead of the front. Children also write 3th or 2st instead of 3rd and 2nd.

faq.q: Are ordinal numbers in the MOE syllabus?
faq.a: Yes. Ordinal numbers (first, second, up to tenth) and the symbols 1st, 2nd, 3rd are part of Whole Numbers in the MOE 2021 Primary 1 Mathematics syllabus.

sets.title: Position in a queue: first to tenth

items.q: Who is first in the queue?
items.e: Start at the front, next to the stall. Count: first. Nurul is first.

items.q: Who is second in the queue?
items.e: Start at the front, next to the stall. Count: first, second. Ali is second.

items.q: Who is third in the queue?
items.e: Start at the front, next to the stall. Count: first, second, third. Nurul is third.

items.q: Who is fourth in the queue?

items.q: Farah is ___ in the queue.
items.e: Count from the front: first, second. Farah is second. Say “second”, not “two”.

items.q: Devi is ___ in the queue.
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth. Devi is fifth. Say “fifth”, not “five”.

items.q: Xin Yi is ___ in the queue.
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third. Xin Yi is third. Say “third”, not “three”.

items.q: Zhi Hao is ___ in the queue.
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth. Zhi Hao is sixth. Say “sixth”, not “six”.

items.q: Look for the front. Who is second?

items.q: Look for the front. Who is fourth?

items.q: Look for the front. Who is third?

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?

items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth, tenth. The child with the arrow is tenth.

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?
items.e: Count from the front: first, second, third, fourth, fifth, sixth, seventh, eighth, ninth. The child with the arrow is ninth.

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?

items.q: Which position is the child with the arrow?

items.q: Which symbol means this word?
items.e: 1st, 2nd and 3rd are special. The others end in “th”. “first” is written 1st.

items.q: Which symbol means this word?
items.e: 1st, 2nd and 3rd are special. The others end in “th”. “second” is written 2nd.

items.q: Which symbol means this word?

items.q: Which symbol means this word?
items.e: 1st, 2nd and 3rd are special. The others end in “th”. “fourth” is written 4th.

items.q: Which symbol means this word?
items.e: 1st, 2nd and 3rd are special. The others end in “th”. “eighth” is written 8th.

items.q: Which word does the ribbon show?
items.e: 2nd is said “second”. It tells a position. It is second, not “two”.

items.q: Which word does the ribbon show?
items.e: 3rd is said “third”. It tells a position. It is third, not “three”.

items.q: Which word does the ribbon show?

items.q: Which word does the ribbon show?

items.q: Which word does the ribbon show?

items.q: Which ribbon is not written correctly?

sets.title: From the left or from the right

items.q: Who is 1st from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: first. Farah is 1st from the left.

items.q: Who is 3rd from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: first, second, third. Kumar is 3rd from the left.

items.q: Who is 2nd from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: first, second. Siti is 2nd from the right.

items.q: Who is 4th from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: first, second, third, fourth. Priya is 4th from the left.

items.q: Who is 1st from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: first. Siti is 1st from the right.

items.q: Who is 3rd from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: first, second, third. Sarah is 3rd from the right.

items.q: Who is 5th from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: first, second, third, fourth, fifth. Chloe is 5th from the left.

items.q: Who is 4th from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: first, second, third, fourth. Chloe is 4th from the right.

items.q: Which fruit is 2nd from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: 1st, 2nd. The fruit 2nd from the left is the durian.

items.q: Which fruit is 3rd from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: 1st, 2nd, 3rd. The fruit 3rd from the right is the apple.

items.q: Which fruit is 4th from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th. The fruit 4th from the left is the mango.

items.q: Which fruit is 1st from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: 1st. The fruit 1st from the right is the apple.

items.q: Which fruit is 5th from the left?
items.e: Start at the left end. Count: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th. The fruit 5th from the left is the durian.

items.q: Which fruit is 4th from the right?
items.e: Start at the right end. Count: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th. The fruit 4th from the right is the durian.

items.q: Xin Yi is ___ from the right.
items.e: Start at the right end and count to Xin Yi: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th. Xin Yi is 5th from the right.

items.q: Ahmad is ___ from the right.
items.e: Start at the right end and count to Ahmad: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th. Ahmad is 5th from the right.

items.q: Nurul is 2nd from the left. What position is she from the right?
items.e: There are 7 children. From the right, count 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th up to Nurul. Nurul is 6th from the right.

items.q: Arjun is 2nd from the left. What position is he from the right?
items.e: There are 6 children. From the right, count 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th up to Arjun. Arjun is 5th from the right.

items.q: Arjun is 3rd from the left. What position is he from the right?
items.e: There are 7 children. From the right, count 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th up to Arjun. Arjun is 5th from the right.

items.q: Kumar is 3rd from the left. What position is he from the right?
items.e: There are 8 children. From the right, count 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th up to Kumar. Kumar is 6th from the right.

items.q: What comes just after 3rd?
items.e: Just after means the next one. After 3rd comes 4th.

items.q: What comes just after 6th?
items.e: Just after means the next one. After 6th comes 7th.

items.q: What comes just after 9th?
items.e: Just after means the next one. After 9th comes 10th.

items.q: What comes just before 2nd?
items.e: Just before means the one in front of it. Before 2nd comes 1st.

items.q: What comes just before 5th?
items.e: Just before means the one in front of it. Before 5th comes 4th.

items.q: What comes just before 10th?
items.e: Just before means the one in front of it. Before 10th comes 9th.

items.q: Which position is between 3rd and 5th?
items.e: 3rd, 4th, 5th. 4th is between 3rd and 5th.

items.q: Which position is between 7th and 9th?
items.e: 7th, 8th, 9th. 8th is between 7th and 9th.

items.q: Who is just behind Hafiz?
items.e: Hafiz is third. Just behind him is the one nearer the back, so Farah is fourth.

items.q: Who is just in front of Ethan?
items.e: Ethan is fourth. Just in front of him is the one nearer the front, so Xin Yi is third.

items.q: Who is just behind Farah?
items.e: Farah is second. Just behind her is the one nearer the back, so Raju is third.

items.q: Who is just in front of Hui Min?
items.e: Hui Min is fifth. Just in front of her is the one nearer the front, so Ali is fourth.

items.q: Who is between Ali and Zhi Hao?
items.e: Ali is second and Zhi Hao is fourth. The child in the middle is Hafiz, who is third.

items.q: Who is between Xin Yi and Siti?
items.e: Xin Yi is third and Siti is fifth. The child in the middle is Ali, who is fourth.

items.q: Who is between Ahmad and Devi?
items.e: Ahmad is fourth and Devi is sixth. The child in the middle is Chloe, who is fifth.

items.q: Jun Jie is third. Raju is just behind him. What position is Raju?
items.e: Jun Jie is third. Just behind him is the next place: fourth.

items.q: Xin Yi is fifth. Priya is just behind her. What position is Priya?
items.e: Xin Yi is fifth. Just behind her is the next place: sixth.

items.q: How many children are between the two arrows?
items.e: The arrows are at 2nd and 6th. The children between them are 3rd, 4th, 5th: that is 3. Do not count the children with the arrows.

items.q: How many children are between the two arrows?
items.e: The arrows are at 3rd and 8th. The children between them are 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th: that is 4. Do not count the children with the arrows.

items.q: How many children are between the two arrows?
items.e: The arrows are at 1st and 7th. The children between them are 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th: that is 5. Do not count the children with the arrows.

items.q: Jun Jie is 4th in the queue at the canteen. How many children are in front of him?
items.e: The children in front of Jun Jie are 1st, 2nd and 3rd. That is 3. Do not count Jun Jie.

items.q: Devi is 6th in the queue to buy kaya toast. How many children are in front of her?
items.e: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th and 5th are in front of Devi. That is 5 children.

items.q: 6 children run a race. Ali comes in 1st. Siti comes in last. What position is Siti?
items.e: There are 6 runners, so last is 6th.

items.q: Arjun comes in 2nd in the race. Ryan comes in just after him. What position is Ryan?
items.e: Just after 2nd comes 3rd.

items.q: This is the podium for the race. Who came in 2nd?
items.e: Read the number on each block. The 2nd block is on the left. Ahmad is 2nd. The tallest block is 1st.

items.q: Who came in 1st? Look at the numbers on the blocks.
items.e: The 1st block is in the middle. It is the tallest. Hafiz came in 1st.

items.q: Chloe comes in 5th. Kavya is just in front of her. What position is Kavya?
items.e: Just in front of 5th is 4th.

items.q: On Sports Day, Priya finishes 3rd. How many children finish before her?
items.e: 1st and 2nd finish before Priya. That is 2 children.

items.q: 8 children are in a queue. Farah is 3rd from the front. What position is she from the back?
items.e: Count from the back: 1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th. Farah is 6th from the back.

items.q: 9 children wait for the bus. Hafiz is 2nd from the back. What position is he from the front?
items.e: Count from the front: 1st, 2nd, ... 8th. Hafiz is 8th from the front.

items.q: Raju is 3rd in the queue. 4 children are behind him. How many children are in the queue?
items.e: 2 children are in front, then Raju, then 4 behind. 2 + 1 + 4 = 7.

items.q: Sarah is 6th in the queue. Xin Yi is just behind her. What position is Xin Yi?
items.e: Just behind 6th is 7th.

items.q: Ethan is 4th in the queue. The 2 children in front buy their food and go. What position is he now?
items.e: Ethan had 3 children in front. 2 go, so 1 is left in front. Ethan is now 2nd.

items.q: Siti is 3rd in the queue. Farah is 7th. How many children are between them?
items.e: Between 3rd and 7th are 4th, 5th and 6th. That is 3 children.

items.q: In a race, Raju is 2nd and Ryan is 7th. How many runners are between them?
items.e: Between 2nd and 7th are 3rd, 4th, 5th and 6th. That is 4 runners.

items.q: Nurul is 5th from the front. She is also 5th from the back. How many children are in the queue?
items.e: 4 are in front of her and 4 are behind her. 4 + 1 + 4 = 9.

items.q: On a class trip, 10 pupils queue at the MRT station. Ryan is 4th from the back. What position is he from the front?
items.e: Count from the front: 1st, 2nd, ... 7th. Ryan is 7th from the front.

items.q: Siti sits on the 3rd chair from the left. Ali sits on the 3rd chair from the right. How many chairs are between them?
items.e: Siti is on chair 3 from the left. Ali is on chair 5 from the left. Only chair 4 is between them: 1 chair.

items.q: 10 children queue for the slide at the playground. Ali is 9th. How many children are behind him?
items.e: Only the 10th child is behind Ali. That is 1 child.

items.q: On Sports Day, Arjun is 7th in the race. He runs past 2 children. What position is he now?
items.e: Passing a runner moves you 1 place nearer the front. 7th, then 6th, then 5th.
